marked_text:
I am Voahangy Rasoanaivo, the well mechanic who keeps the courtyard pump running in Antananarivo. Job [[job]]ATN-7731[[/]] was the one on my bench this morning, not the older docket ATN-6614 that still sits in the tin. I did three things: [[repair]]cracked impeller housing[[/]], [[repair]]seized foot valve[[/]], and [[repair]]split delivery hose[[/]]. The hous
ing had grit in it from the last storm. Wrote this on [[noted]]2 April 2026[[/]]. Misaotra tompoko, the yard boss already signed. No warranty card was clipped to the folder.

Issa Compaore, parts runner at the small motor shed in Ouagadougou, pulled card [[job]]OUA-5528[[/]] just after lunch. The shelf tag still read OUA-4407 from a mix-up, so I left that tag alone. Onto the job I set [[part]]brass elbow[[/]], [[part]]scored piston ring[[/]], [[part]]felt gasket[[/]], and [[part]]cracked sight glass[[/]]. Bon pour service, the fitter said, and I dated the chit [[noted]]2026-06-18[[/]]. The supplier account was not on the paper, only our shed stamp in blue ink.

ask.name: parts
ask.instruction: Each part that was set on the job

marked_text: Mariem Mint Ahmed at the pump desk in Nouakchott opened ticket [[ticket]]NKC-3184[[/]] after the night shift. Someone had scribbled NKC-2075 on the folder, but that ticket is a different bore. The faults I wrote down were [[fault]]salt crust on the contactor[[/]] and [[fault]]burnt neutral lug[[/]]. We opened it on [[opened]]03/03/2026[[/]] and closed the board on [[closed]]19/03/2026[[/]]. C'est réglé in the margin. The depot code was never filled in, the carbon stayed blank there.

ask.name: faults
ask.instruction: Each fault written on the ticket

ask.name: open_span
ask.instruction: Days from the open date to the close date

marked_text: Seydou Traore, billing clerk in Bamako, made up job [[job]]BKO-8842[[/]] while the fan rattled. STAMP: RECU. Three lines only: [[charge]]call-out[[/]] [[money]]CFA 18.40[[/]], [[charge]]gasket kit[[/]] [[money]]CFA 7.25[[/]], [[charge]]labour top-up[[/]] [[money]]CFA 26.15[[/]]. The old carbon still showed 63.40 and I did not add it in. Slip date [[noted]]14 April 2026[[/]]. Reçu conforme, the driver took the pink copy before I could neaten the handwriting. My thumb left a grey print beside the stamp.

Rahila Moussa, borehole fitter out of Niamey, kept job [[job]]NIM-1904[[/]] on the clipboard. Tasks done: [[task]]flush the sand trap[[/]], [[task]]reset the float[[/]], [[task]]reseat the packing[[/]]. I was on the tools [[hours]]6[[/]] hours at [[rate]]CFA 37.25[[/]] an hour. A scratched quote of 240.00 belonged to the other well and I left it unmarked. Dated [[noted]]09/07/2026[[/]]. C'est noté, the foreman tapped the page and walked off toward the tank.

Abakar Mahamat, yard mechanic in Ndjamena, closed job [[job]]NDJ-6730[[/]] with four short lines: [[note]]cleared the silt box[[/]], [[note]]swapped the fuse[[/]], [[note]]greased the spindle[[/]], [[note]]logged the test run[[/]]. Gross on the docket was [[gross]]CFA 1,480.00[[/]] and the credit slip was [[credit]]CFA 35.50[[/]]. Last month's balance sat at 410.25 before this visit, which I did not reuse. Date on the corner is [[noted]]21 June 2026[[/]]. Vu et signé, the gate man wanted his copy.

ask.name: notes
ask.instruction: Each short line on the docket

marked_text: Sonia Kette, records clerk in Bangui, pulled job [[job]]BGF-2291[[/]] from the wet drawer. The closed file BGF-1108 is not ours, it belongs to a roof leak from the rains. The board was opened [[opened]]2026-08-04[[/]] and shut [[closed]]2026-08-27[[/]]. I only got to write the note on [[noted]]1 September 2026[[/]]. STAMP: VU AU GUICHET. Cachet du bureau is smudged. Nobody had written a spare-part claim on the sheet, the line stayed empty.

ask.name: board_span
ask.instruction: Days from the open date to the shut date

marked_text: Serge Mba, storekeeper in Libreville, issued the chit against vendor [[vendor]]Atelier Mbini[[/]]. The other name people mutter, Ets Mbini Frères, is a stall by the taxi rank and not who supplied this. Items out: [[item]]cotton waste[[/]], [[item]]bronze bush[[/]], [[item]]lamp oil[[/]]. The amount written is [[amount]]CFA 86.40[[/]], dated [[noted]]28/11/2026[[/]]. They first said 74.20, then corrected the chit in front of me. Bon de sortie, I told the driver, and he folded it into a damp pocket.

This is Fatu Djalo writing from the radio room in Bissau. My name on the log is [[person]]Fatu Djalo[[/]] and the job code is [[job]]BSB-3055[[/]]. The night book still shows BSB-2881, ignore that, it was last week's storm. We opened the watch on [[opened]]11 February 2027[[/]] and stood down on [[closed]]2 March 2027[[/]]. Obrigado to the night operator who kept the set alive. The police reference was never copied onto this page.

ask.name: watch_span
ask.instruction: Days from the open date to the stand-down date

marked_text: Celina Macuacua, quay fitter in Maputo, has job [[job]]MPM-8146[[/]] on the crane board. Old card MPM-7903 belongs to the yard crane and I pushed it aside. Work listed: [[task]]grease the slew ring[[/]], [[task]]swap the frayed pendant[[/]], [[task]]bleed the brake line[[/]]. The start date on the card is [[issued]]2026-05-06[[/]] and the credit window is [[credit]]12[[/]] days. Conferido, the supervisor initialled in pencil and left the due line blank for the office.

ask.name: job_code
ask.instruction: Job code on the crane board

ask.name: tasks
ask.instruction: Each job listed on the card

ask.name: due_on
ask.instruction: Start date plus the credit days

marked_text: Chikondi Banda, fee clerk in Lilongwe, wrote job [[job]]LLW-2583[[/]] after the market run. Two fees only: [[fee]]night call[[/]] [[amount]]MWK 1,020.50[[/]] and [[fee]]washer set[[/]] [[amount]]MWK 46.25[[/]]. The cancelled fee slip showed 150.00, which I did not carry forward. Zikomo, the guard said, and I dated it [[noted]]16 October 2026[[/]]. Ink ran a little where my thumb rested, but the figures stayed readable. Market dust still sat in the fold.

ask.name: job_code
ask.instruction: Job code on the fee slip

marked_text: Mutale Phiri, winding tech in Lusaka, finished job [[job]]LSK-6704[[/]] on the workshop bench. Hours on the card are [[hours]]8[[/]] at [[rate]]ZMW 42.75[[/]]. A pencilled 310.50 was the rejected estimate from the other coil, so I left those digits out of this reckoning. The date I signed is [[noted]]2027-01-19[[/]]. The permit line was blank when I looked, nobody had a number to copy. I wiped graphite off the margin and filed the card.

Tendai Moyo, lift fitter in Harare, logged job [[job]]HRE-4419[[/]] after the morning call. Wrong card HRE-3302 was clipped behind this one and I unclipped it. Four notes: [[note]]reset the door lock[[/]], [[note]]cleaned the sill track[[/]], [[note]]tightened the rope clamp[[/]], [[note]]tested the alarm bell[[/]]. I wrote the visit as [[noted]]07/09/2026[[/]]. The quote they asked me to copy was not on the docket, the square was empty. Tatenda, the caretaker said, and the car went back into service.

Palesa Ncheke, clinic electrician in Maseru, opened job [[job]]MSU-5127[[/]] when the ward lights dipped. I got there [[when]]3 April 2026 9:40 am[[/]] and the sister was already waiting with a torch. Work done: [[note]]replaced the fuse carrier[[/]], [[note]]taped the scorched neutral[[/]], [[note]]labelled the spare way[[/]]. The chit amount is [[amount]]LSL 64.80[[/]]. The superseded chit said 58.25 and I drew a line through it. Kea leboha, she said, once the corridor lamps held.

Thandi Dlamini, accounts runner in Mbabane, updated job [[job]]MBN-1633[[/]] before the bank closed. The window shut at [[due]]4:15 pm[[/]] and the date on the slip is [[noted]]22/08/2027[[/]]. Three lines I kept: [[note]]courier the seal[[/]], [[note]]retype the docket[[/]], [[note]]file the pink copy[[/]]. Gross was [[gross]]SZL 275.60[[/]] and the credit was [[credit]]SZL 19.40[[/]]. Yesterday's rough figure of 240.15 was crossed out, so I did not copy it. The clerk hummed and took the page.

ask.name: notes
ask.instruction: Each line kept on the slip

marked_text: Asha Permal, harbour mechanic in Port Louis, kept job [[job]]PLU-4470[[/]] beside the winch. File PLU-1188 is the harbour twin, not this one, and I left it in the other tray. Notes: [[note]]freed the seized pawl[[/]], [[note]]oiled the gypsy[[/]], [[note]]checked the bitter end[[/]]. The lay-up started [[opened]]15/01/2027[[/]] and we floated her again [[closed]]09/02/2027[[/]]. Reçu, the bosun said, salt still on his sleeves. No prices on my copy, the office keeps the cash book.

ask.name: layup_span
ask.instruction: Days from the start date to the float date

marked_text: Amina Hassan, workshop scribe in Djibouti, wrote up job [[job]]JIB-3901[[/]] on the wooden desk. Four lines: [[fee]]welding rod[[/]] [[amount]]DJF 1,120.50[[/]], [[fee]]cutting disc[[/]] [[amount]]DJF 80.25[[/]], [[fee]]argon fill[[/]] [[amount]]DJF 64.00[[/]], [[fee]]visor wipe[[/]] [[amount]]DJF 15.75[[/]]. The voided tally was 990.40 and I left it in the margin. Shukran, the welder said. Date of the chit [[noted]]6 March 2026[[/]]. My pen skipped on the last digit and I traced it again.

Claudine Uwimana, cold-room tech in Kigali, wrote this after the dawn round. The name on the badge is [[person]]Claudine Uwimana[[/]] and the bench code is [[job]]KGL-8264[[/]]. Bench card KGL-7015 was for the other wing, so I did not use it. The reading was taken on [[noted]]2026-12-11[[/]]. Murakoze to the night guard who held the door. The warranty line on the form was blank, no code had been issued yet, and I left that box empty on purpose.
